concern: (low) Generic FinTech archetype references and placeholders are present instead of specialized knowledge-base domain terminology.
jtbd: When navigating the CRIE knowledge base interface, I want to see epidemiological, normative, and academic terms rather than generic FinTech terminology, so that I can immediately orient myself within the clinical-epidemiological domain without cognitive friction or confusion.

concern: (low) Form controls lack explicit visual definitions for interactive validation error states.
jtbd: When inputting parameters into the control form with invalid or missing values, I want distinct and accessible visual error states (such as high-contrast border highlights, error message containers, and aria-invalid attributes), so that I can immediately recognize and rectify input mistakes without ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the control parameters form in the mockup, When form controls enter an invalid state, Then the inputs display an explicit visual error style (e.g. border-rose-500, ring-rose-500, text-rose-400), an error text message block linked via aria-describedby is rendered below the field, and aria-invalid='true' is present.
